mu_name_from: MuMain's MONSTER_MODEL_DEVIL = 26, so OpenMonsterModel loads Monster27.bmd; the server's type is MONSTER_DEVIL = 37. The client's name is 데빌 (ZzzCharacter.cpp:13877-13881). OpenMU's Version075 LostTower.cs:755-786 names number 37 'Devil' at level 60 with 5000 health, 180-195 damage, 115 defense, MoveRange 3, AttackRange 4, ViewRange 7, AttackDelay 2000, AttackSkill Lightning (3). 54 spots: 15 on Lost Tower 4, 19 on 5, 12 on 6, 8 on 7.
monster_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:13877-13881, CreateMonster, case MONSTER_DEVIL: `c->Object.Scale = 1.1f;` -- no weapon, no Level. MoveCharacterVisual scrolls its BlendMeshTexCoordU (:6016-6018), but no BlendMesh is ever set for it, so nothing reads the scroll.
rig_from: Seven actions, slots 0 to 6, exported with --actions=0,1,2,3,4,5,6. Keys: 6, 6, 7, 6, 6, 6, 11. 55 bones, a biped with the player's grip names (knife_gdf 16, hand_bofdgne01 25 -- CreateCharacter's `case MODEL_DEVIL: Weapon[0].LinkBone = 16; Weapon[1].LinkBone = 25`, holding nothing) and a five-bone tail. BoneHead = 6, Bip01 Head (ZzzOpenData.cpp:3595). OpenMonsterModel's default play speeds.
sheet_from: One sheet, Data/Monster/satan_a.OZT, 256 by 256, alpha cutting 7% -- thin lines through the plates -- on all 662 triangles. Decoded under a devil_ prefix. Its own alpha is the cutout, as MU alpha-tests it.
sheet_materials_from: Read off the sheet: a dark bronze-brown hide in ridged, segmented plates -- horns, a ribbed tail, clawed limbs and a horned face with pale eyes -- a creature's own body, not worn metal, so skin, the monster default.
effects_from: Its blow is Lightning (AttackSkill 3), so the game calls the hero's own Lightning at its swing, as for the Thunder Lich (game/play.cpp, thunderCasts_). MU draws its own for it instead -- four BITMAP_JOINT_LASER+1 and fire from both hands with SOUND_EVIL (ZzzCharacter.cpp:2295-2313) -- not built yet.
sounds_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:3590-3596: mYeti1, mSatanAttack1 and mYetiDie, SetMonsterSound(..., 105, 105, 106, 106, 107): the move is mYeti1, the attack and the flinch mSatanAttack1, the death mYetiDie. Wired as devil_*.
